prompts.prompt: Create a NEW production game VFX transparent sprite atlas, not a screenshot. Cute clean hand-pixel-art for a bright Korean 2D roguelite, no noisy AI speckling, NO blur, NO bloom, no gradients outside silhouettes, limited palette shading with pixel clusters and a thin darker colored outline. These sprites will be shown very small, so each must be legible at 16-32 pixels. Canvas 1536x1024 landscape, exactly a 3 column x 2 row grid of equal cells. Five isolated sprites centered in cells with at least 25% transparent padding in each cell. Top-left = Ashi wind; top-middle = Ari stone/feather; top-right = Hyuki ice; bottom-left = Shini ember; bottom-middle = neutral needle disappearance; bottom-right MUST be entirely empty. No text, no labels, no frames, no white dots, no characters, no shadows. Real alpha transparent background. Each cell has ONE compact motif only. Variant A, restrained collectible-particle shapes. Ashi: ONE small mint-green curved leaf with simple vein, diagonal. Ari: ONE smooth rounded honey-cream pebble with tiny warm pink highlight, NOT an egg or face. Hyuki: ONE small ice-blue diamond shard, two clean facets. Shini: ONE short golden orange ember flame leaning right with coral outer edge, no face. Neutral needle disappearance: a small ivory-gold four-point glint with TWO tiny detached gold chip flecks, no ring. Deliberately minimal.
